State agencies should provide outreach information regarding what is required to manage hunters in a way that will result in meaningful population reductions. This effort could be facilitated by professional organizations, such as The Wildlife Society, by establishing an overabundant deer position statement, which would ad- vise best management practices for state agencies and mu- nicipalities alike to achieve the difﬁcult long-term goal of maintaining suburban deer densities at <10 deer/km 2. CAMPBELL: Yes GALLAGHER: Yes! CAMPBELL: Yes GALLAGHER: Trustee Serradas SERRADAS: Yes GALLAGHER: Mayor Gallagher GALLAGHER: No SERRADAS: I would also like to make one more Motion, if I may. GALLAGHER: Wait one second. I just wanna explain what you… basically what you…what you said to me is to go and tell the county that we’re gonna move our village offices. CAMPBELL: No, not the village offices. I saying…I was saying other possibilities… GALLAGHER: Oh…oh…can I… can I… CAMPBELL: I wasn’t saying what you’re talking about Airinhos. GALLAGHER: Can I…can I…Let me just clarify. The Motion was to include village hall moving to Butterfield in the project. CAMPBELL: Illegible…sorry… GALLAGHER: Ok. Let me…Let me take the vote again. Trustee Hustis HUSTIS: Yes GALLAGHER: Trustee Campbell CAMPBELL: No GALLAGHER: Trustee Serradas SERRADAS: Would you read the Motion again please. GALLAGHER: Trustee Serradas moves to include moving village hall to Butterfield. SERRADAS: I moved to consider it. GALLAGHER: No! No! This is stuff that I…. SERRADAS: Ok…ok fine; fine GALLAGHER: Ok, very good. Trustee Serradas, yes. Mayor Gallagher, No. The Motion does not pass. SERRADAS: I disagree. You’re supposed to vote on the tie. There’s no tie. GALLAGHER: No I can vote anytime I want. CAMPBELL: My discussion…what I discussed was to the possibility of other things… GALLAGHER: It doesn’t matter. You need three votes to pass and I can vote anytime I want. I vote on every single Motion we take where there is not a tie. SERRADAS: I understand that but if there’s a tie…that’s…prove me otherwise…when there’s a tie… GALLAGHER: I’m proving you otherwise. Its law. Its state law. I have a vote anytime this board votes. Doesn’t matter whether there’s a tie or not. And anyway you need three votes to pass. No Motion can pass unless it has three votes.

Trustee Serradas stated that he was in favor of consolidation of all services as much as possible. Trustee Serradas moved to include Village Hall to the Butterfield site and seconded by Trustee Hustis. On roll call vote: Trustee Hustis voting yes Trustee Campbell voting no Trustee Serradas voting yes Mayor Gallagher voting no
